d:
BJP Padyatra : bhagalpur men aaj bijepi ki padyatra nikali jaegi. parti ke rashtriy adhyaksh nitin navin is padyatra men shamil honge. lajpat park se padyatra ki shuruaat hogi. bijepi ki or se chalae ja rahe 'loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao' abhiyan ke tahat is karyakram ka aayojan kiya ja raha hai. is dauran parti ke neta aur karyakarta bari sankhya men shamil honge.
